description: This file defines classes and objects for continuous Kafka stream processing within Apache Spark, including stream initialization, partition management, and data reading logic.

classes.name: KafkaContinuousStream
classes.description: A continuous stream implementation for Kafka data, managing offsets, partitions, and data loss scenarios.

classes.name: KafkaContinuousInputPartition
classes.description: Represents a partition of Kafka data for continuous processing, including start offset and consumer parameters.

classes.name: KafkaContinuousReaderFactory
classes.description: Factory object to create Kafka partition readers for continuous processing.

classes.name: KafkaContinuousPartitionReader
classes.description: Reads data from a Kafka partition continuously, handling offset management and data conversion.

methods.name: initialOffset
methods.description: Determines the initial offset for the Kafka stream based on configuration.

methods.name: deserializeOffset
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a KafkaSourceOffset object.

methods.name: planInputPartitions
methods.description: Plans and creates input partitions for the Kafka stream based on current offsets.

methods.name: createContinuousReaderFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for continuous partition readers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Kafka stream and releases resources.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the end offset (no implementation here).

methods.name: mergeOffsets
methods.description: Merges multiple partition offsets into a single offset.

methods.name: needsReconfiguration
methods.description: Checks if reconfiguration of the stream is needed based on latest offsets.

methods.name: reportDataLoss
methods.description: Handles data loss scenarios, throwing exceptions or logging warnings based on configuration.
